title.en: Co-translated book selected as a 2026 Outstanding Academic Book

text.en: “The Natural Laws of Complex Networks: Universal Principles Revealed by Statistical Physics” (Acorn Publishing), co-translated by Eun Lee, was selected in the natural sciences category by the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea.
text.ko: 이은 교수가 공역한 『복잡계 네트워크의 자연법칙: 통계물리학이 밝히는 네트워크의 보편 원리』(에이콘출판)가 대한민국학술원 2026년 우수학술도서(자연과학 분야)로 선정되었습니다.

title.en: Lab team selected for the 2026 Datory Lab fellowship

text.en: Jin Gyeong Won and Chihyun Park (MS) with Sangheon Park and Hyeonmin Roh (BS), advised by Eun Lee and Jiyoung Kang, were selected for the 2026 Data Open Lab / Datory Lab fellowship run by Busan Technopark. The project analyses evacuation-vulnerability indices for disaster-vulnerable populations in Busan.
text.ko: 진경원·박치현(석사과정), 박상헌·노현민(학부), 지도교수 이은·강지영 팀이 부산테크노파크의 2026년 데이터 오픈랩 활용 Datory Lab 운영 지원사업(펠로우십)에 선정되었습니다. 부산 지역 재난 취약계층의 대피 취약성 지수를 분석하고 개선 방안을 제안하는 과제입니다.

title.en: Excellence Award, Busan Datory Lab programme 2024

text.en: The lab received an Excellence Award in the 2024 Busan Datory Lab support programme.

title.en: Korean translation of “The Science of Science” published

text.en: The Korean translation of The Science of Science is out.
